external_changes.name: MCP official servers v2.3.0
external_changes.change: Filesystem 2.2.0 supports --read-only and --confine-roots; mcp-server-fetch 2026.11.4 supports --allowed-hosts plus configurable timeout and bounded subprocess for Readability.
external_changes.why: Can constrain the filesystem and remote content scopes of an autonomous JARVIS tool worker, mitigating accidental/destructive operations.
external_changes.apply: JARVIS MCP file and fetch gateways
external_changes.risk: Actual package adoption unverified. TS MCP servers v2 series require Node.js >=24 per prior official v2.0 release; observed 191 runtime Node v22.19.0 is not an upgrade-ready runtime; check dependencies and run isolated compatibility test first.

external_changes.name: LangGraph Python 1.2.20
external_changes.change: Assign per-interrupt IDs; introduce strict resume mode that rejects stale interrupt answers.
external_changes.why: JARVIS human-approval/paused agent tasks can reject answers belonging to old interrupts, avoiding wrong approval/resumption.
external_changes.apply: Agent Workspace run pause/resume and human approval gates
external_changes.risk: This is Python LangGraph; actual library in use is UNVERIFIED. Older resume clients may require compatibility updates; not applied.

external_changes.name: Home Assistant Core 2026.11.0
external_changes.change: LLM API agents can inspect system details and available actions, invoke actions, list/reload integrations; MCP server can limit exposure to read-only tools; conversations can only be continued by their originating user.
external_changes.why: Provides an access separation pattern for future JARVIS device control and operator diagnostics.
external_changes.apply: Home Assistant Assist-to-JARVIS device action gateway
external_changes.risk: Action invocation and log viewing require careful authorization (system log access requires administrator); HA usage in BIGWASH is UNVERIFIED. Existing Home Assistant entity naming may change, test migrations first.
